controls.label: Nose width
controls.summary: Narrow or widen the whole nose

controls.label: Nose bridge
controls.summary: Narrow or widen the upper nose only

controls.label: Nose tip
controls.summary: Lift or lower the tip, leaving the nostril wings

controls.label: Nose length
controls.summary: Shorten or lengthen the nose from its root

controls.label: Lip fullness
controls.summary: Thinner or fuller lips, both together

controls.label: Lip corners
controls.summary: Lift or lower the corners of the mouth

controls.label: Eye size
controls.summary: Smaller or larger eyes, scaled about the iris

controls.label: Eye opening
controls.summary: Less or more open eyes, height only

controls.label: Brow tail
controls.summary: Lower or lift the outer tail

spec.description: Face part controls of the 40-control set: nose, lips, eyes and brows. Opt-in, local, photo-only simulations. Scale caps are fractions of the part's own size; shift caps are percentages of interocular distance.

brows.label: Brow reshape simulation. Geometry only: no tint, and no promise of a lift.
brows.title: Brows

eyes.label: Eye size simulation. The eye opening never changes by more than 12%.
eyes.title: Eyes

lips.label: Lip size and shape preview to discuss with a professional. A photo simulation, not a predicted treatment result.
lips.title: Lips

nose.label: Nose reshape decision preview. A photo simulation to help you think a choice through; it does not predict the result of any treatment.
nose.title: Nose
